```{ojs}
//| echo: false
iaColumns = [
  { key: "Outil",                          label: "Outil",     type: "stack",     urlKey: "URL", subKey: "Éditeur"                              },
  { key: "Statut",                         label: "Statut",    type: "badge"                                                                    },
  { key: "Gratuit (Limites)",              label: "Tarif",     type: "pricing",   payKey: "Payant (Prix & Limites)"                             },
  { key: "Entrée / Sortie",               label: "I/O",       type: "io-badges", sortable: false                                               },
  { key: "Spécificité / Usage recommandé", label: "Point fort", type: "tooltip",  sortable: false                                               }
]

iaOpts = ({ columns: iaColumns, pageSize: 20 })

data_generalistes    = FileAttachment("sources/01_generalistes.csv").csv()
data_images          = FileAttachment("sources/02_images.csv").csv()
data_video           = FileAttachment("sources/03_video.csv").csv()
data_audio           = FileAttachment("sources/04_audio_tts.csv").csv()
data_musique         = FileAttachment("sources/05_musique.csv").csv()
data_3d              = FileAttachment("sources/06_3d.csv").csv()
data_recherche       = FileAttachment("sources/07_recherche.csv").csv()
data_code            = FileAttachment("sources/08_code_vibe_coding.csv").csv()
data_ui              = FileAttachment("sources/09_ui_graphisme.csv").csv()
data_automatisation  = FileAttachment("sources/10_automatisation.csv").csv()
data_compute         = FileAttachment("sources/11_compute_inference.csv").csv()

dt_generalistes   = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-generalistes",   data_generalistes,   iaOpts)
dt_images         = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-images",         data_images,         iaOpts)
dt_video          = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-video",          data_video,          iaOpts)
dt_audio          = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-audio",          data_audio,          iaOpts)
dt_musique        = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-musique",        data_musique,        iaOpts)
dt_3d             = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-3d",             data_3d,             iaOpts)
dt_recherche      = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-recherche",      data_recherche,      iaOpts)
dt_code           = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-code",           data_code,           iaOpts)
dt_ui             = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-ui",             data_ui,             iaOpts)
dt_automatisation = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-automatisation", data_automatisation, iaOpts)
dt_compute        = aptitek.createDataTable("#dt-compute",        data_compute,        iaOpts)
```
